title: Odoo Implementation
tagline: Configure Odoo for a real business, app by app: Accounting, CRM and Sales, Purchase, Inventory, Human Resources and Manufacturing.
description: A hands-on course for functional consultants, implementers and key users who set up Odoo for a company. It starts with the implementation cycle, then shows how each application is configured and how its business cycle runs.

You will work through six applications in depth, from the core flows to advanced options such as purchase approvals, routes and drop-shipping, lots and expiry dates, landed costs, payroll and MRP planning. Every lesson ends with a quick check, and a final assessment leads to your certificate.
learningOutcomes: Apply the implementation cycle to an Odoo project
Configure Accounting for customers, vendors and the full accounting cycle
Set up the CRM and sales cycles
Configure purchasing with agreements, approvals, alternatives and warnings
Design warehouses, locations, routes and traceability with lots and serial numbers
Set up Human Resources, from employees and contracts to payroll and recruitment
Plan manufacturing with bills of materials, work centers and MRP
whoItsFor: Functional consultants configuring Odoo for clients
Odoo implementers and ERP key users responsible for setting up company processes
System admins moving from platform management into functional configuration
Operations and finance professionals who want to see how their department runs in Odoo

curriculum.title: Accounting
curriculum.description: The implementation cycle, the Accounting dashboard, customers, vendors and the full accounting cycle.

curriculum.title: CRM and Sales
curriculum.description: The CRM pipeline and the sales cycle from quotation to order.

curriculum.title: Purchase
curriculum.description: RFQs and purchase orders, purchase agreements, vendor bills, approvals, alternatives, and product and vendor warnings.

curriculum.title: Inventory Setup
curriculum.description: Warehouses, locations, operation types, routes, drop-shipping, putaway rules and packages.

curriculum.title: Products and Inventory Operations
curriculum.description: Product categories, templates and variants, units of measure, lots and serial numbers, expiry dates, reordering rules, landed costs, scrap, consignment, batch and wave transfers, adjustments and reports.

curriculum.title: Human Resources
curriculum.description: Departments, employees, contracts, time off, attendance, payroll, payslips and recruitment.

curriculum.title: Manufacturing and Final Assessment
curriculum.description: Manufacturing orders, bills of materials, operations, work centers and MRP planning, followed by the final assessment.

projects.title: Multi-App Configuration
projects.description: Set up Accounting, Sales, Purchase and Inventory so they work together for one company.

projects.title: Warehouse Design
projects.description: Configure warehouses, locations, routes and reordering rules for a realistic product range.

projects.title: People and Production
projects.description: Configure employees, contracts and payroll, then plan production with bills of materials and work centers.

faq.question: Is this a technical development course?
faq.answer: No. It is a functional course about configuring Odoo applications. No programming is needed.

faq.question: What should I know before starting?
faq.answer: Comfortable everyday use of Odoo. The Odoo User Guide or the Crash Course Odoo ERP are good preparation.

faq.question: Which apps are covered?
faq.answer: Accounting, CRM, Sales, Purchase, Inventory, Human Resources and Manufacturing.

faq.question: What roles can this support?
faq.answer: Functional consultants, Odoo implementers, ERP key users and implementation-support roles.

instructor.name: Maram
instructor.bio: Analyzes operational challenges and helps translate business requirements into clear ERP learning and implementation concepts.
